elements.manual_reason: Outgoing Workday / Adaptive Planning logo lockup has faded out by the end frame; only a faint ghost remains, so no candidate box covers it.
elements.label: Workday Adaptive Planning logo (outgoing)

pattern.description: The logo lockup dissolves out to white and the section title fades in at the same centre position, its colour deepening from pale blue to full navy as it settles.
pattern.why_premium: Sequential out-then-in dissolve on a clean white field keeps the eye anchored at centre; the title resolving from a tint to full brand navy gives a soft 'ink settling' finish instead of a hard cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.logo', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.in'}).fromTo('.title', {opacity: 0, color: '#c9d6ec'}, {opacity: 1, color: '#0b3a8f', duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.out'}, '-=0.05'); no stagger, whole-line reveal.
build_hint.remotion: logoOpacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [1, 0], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad)}); titleOpacity = interpolate(frame, [5, 16], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); interpolateColors over the same range from pale blue to navy. Ease, not spring.

notes: No visible blur in frames; this is a plain opacity crossfade plus colour deepening, mapped to blur_crossfade as the closest pattern. Title text is verbatim as on screen ('Forcasting' typo is in the source). b02-b04 are OCR fragments / ghost diff of the same title and logo remnant.
